response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average) AS avg_margin FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_analyst_count FROM type_averages ORDER BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: “Snapshot's trader type” uses the snapshot's optional trdref2 trader reference; rows without a matched trader or a known trader type are excluded.
